posts.text:
Democrats are fighting hard to make life more affordable. 

Meanwhile. 

Republicans are busy fighting each other and bending the knee.

The American people will decide who controls Congress in November. 

Not far-right extremists on the Supreme Court. 

Send them all a powerful message that enough is enough.

Republicans care more about war in the Middle East than making life affordable for the Middle Class. 

You deserve better.

The high cost of living is out of control and Republicans don’t give a damn.

Video

The ghosts of the confederacy have afflicted the Supreme Court.

And are haunting the nation.

Shameful.

Video

The reckless Republican war of choice in Iran is crushing the financial situation of the American people.

Donald Trump just made clear he doesn’t give a damn.

At what point have you had enough?

Video

Inflation just hit a 3-year high, gas prices are out of control and life under Donald Trump is unaffordable.

But this guy spent all night rage-posting on social media.

Can someone do a wellness check?

There is nothing the extremists can do to gerrymander away the reality of their failed record.

The Republican economy is a disaster for working class Americans.

Republican extremists have to cheat to win. The American people will have the last word.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Video
The decision by the Virginia Supreme Court to overturn the will of more than three million voters will not stand.

The average gas price is now $4.55 per gallon.

Is this what the golden age in America looks like?

The Knicks are up 2-0 and I have to wake up to another deranged rant from this guy.

Gas prices are sky high, grocery bills are surging and families can't catch a break.

Democrats are about to take back the House and you're losing your mind.

Where's the luv?

Working class Americans are maxing out their credit cards to pay for groceries and gas.

The Trump Cartel thinks this is something to celebrate.

Shameful.

Video

Gas prices are rising toward $5 a gallon because of the reckless Republican war of choice in Iran.

Enough.

House Democrats will continue to respond decisively to the Supreme Court decision gutting the Voting Rights Act.

We will never let far right extremists rig the midterm elections and beyond.

Gas prices were under $3.00 a gallon before the reckless Republican war of choice in the Middle East. 

Today it is $4.45.

You deserve better.
